positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Serving as ETL Lead on an agile team.
* Designed ETL Flow using Korn Shell scripts that utilize DB2 data movement utilities such as EXPORT TO, LOAD/REPLACE, LOAD/INSERT, INGEST. Created the process flow to work within a Control-M solution, which allows our team to monitor the flow activity in production. The scripts utilize Vault by HashiCorp to acquire secrets to connect to databases and for FTP connectivity. Provide maintenance and support for this project.
* Optimized ETL flow processing 500+ million rows of data daily to reduce the time from 48 hours to 10 hours.
* Storing our scripts in GIT for version control. Assisted in building out a CI/CD Pipeline for script/file deployment that includes unit testing and manager approval process for the deployment activity to be completed.
* Building ETL flows using AWS Glue Studio, using Athena to build queries to create the data movement flow and validate results, and utilizing S3 targets with Parquet file format.
* Mentoring our team developers regarding SQL, design logic, and unit testing for story cards that they are working on. These developers are both internal and external, local and offsite/offshore.
* Completing work at home since Covid-19 lockdowns happened, utilizing VPN access, email, instant messaging through Skype, and online meetings using Skype - in some cases Zoom.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: Buy, sell, rent, and rehab real estate properties.

positions.title: IT Analyst - Solutions
positions.description:
* Served as ETL Lead on an agile team.
* Served as a Product Owner on a SAFE Agile Data Movement Team. As Product Owner, I worked with business partners to gather requirements and write story cards for our team backlog. Engaged agile team in story card review sessions to answer questions, provide clarifications, and size story cards. Worked on planning out iterations based on priorities gained for business partners. Provided demonstrations to our business partners to gain acceptance of the completed story card work. Informatica was the primary tool used to complete our ETL story cards.
* Guided Agile Team through a process to trace SQL Server calls to determine commands interacting with database along with tables and columns used. This work included instructing the team on performing the trace, reading the results, and pulling out the information we were looking to gather.

positions.title: Data Specialist - Database Admin
positions.description:
* Informatica, SQL Server, SQL, PostgreSQL, DB2
* Served as ETL Lead on an agile team.
* Served as a Product Owner on a SAFE Agile Data Movement Team. As Product Owner, I worked with business partners to gather requirements and write story cards for our team backlog. Engaged agile team in story card review sessions to answer questions, provide clarifications, and size story cards. * * Worked on planning out iterations based on priorities gained for business partners. Provided demonstrations to our business partners to gain acceptance of the completed story card work. Informatica was the primary tool used to complete our ETL story cards.
* Worked on a data quality project utilizing Microsoft SQL Server to validate data using SQL in SSMS. Built queries to apply data fixes based on business rules from the validation findings.
* Designed and built Informatica mappings for ETL using a variety of transformations. The mappings used text files and mainframe database connections for data sourcing. The targets for these mappings were text files, and an FTP process transferred these text files to another department to consume into their data sources.
